question: What was measured for resource options after the flow-test speed-up?
workload: 2026-10-31: resource options after the flow-test speed-up
method: Transcribed from the cited historical record. Units and precision follow the source.
finding: Reported observations and context: - Linker (lld/mold), tmpfs target dir, a cargo job cap, a smaller Nx copy: not done. Measured on c21ca8c (a fully cold build, 25 min flow-tests): CPU 97% average, I/O wait 2% average (peak 15%); the Nx contract copy is 17 MB of tracked files. The bottleneck is CPU, which none of these moves; the runner image has no lld/clang to verify on, and a changed linker flag cold-starts sccache.
